title: Most Nepal government websites are back online after the PHP2Shell shutdown; Nagarik app still down
summary: Thousands of sites on the shared GIWMS platform were patched centrally; vendor-managed sites are returning gradually, the SDOC says.

title: KB Kookmin Bank resumes its tablet-branch service after a five-day PHP shutdown on the regulator's advice
summary: The service went off at about 18:00 on Oct 21 on the Financial Supervisory Service's recommendation and came back Oct 26.

title: 'Killa' wins the $2,000 StealMyBitcoin challenge with PHP2Shell after 19 hours, publishes a proof of concept
summary: The unpatched PHP server fell at 15:47 UTC Oct 25; the published script worked in about seven of ten lab runs.

title: PHP2Shell reaches IBM i shops: Zend backports fixes to end-of-life PHP as 'Black October' patching drags on
summary: Amazon saw exploitation attempts from Oct 17; Dutch, French, Danish and Finnish governments took sites offline.

title: Korean security press: Unit 42 withdraws its PHP2Shell intrusion analysis, cannot confirm the entry route
summary: The correction withdraws the judgment about the cause, not the intrusion itself; KISA's own advisory stands.

title: Pennsylvania police: mall worker used Grok to turn a teenage girl's photo into abuse material; hearing Oct 30
summary: Hundreds of AI-generated images and 150-plus covert recordings found on seized devices, per NBC10; arrested Oct 21, out on bail.

title: Texas county judge's campaign pulls an AI video of Black residents endorsing him, says 'a Democrat' made it
summary: Warped backgrounds and one voice for four speakers gave it away; the campaign has not said where the video came from.

title: Indian Army flags a deepfake of a serving general 'admitting' China took three areas of Arunachal Pradesh
summary: Footage came from a 2023 Kashmir briefing; the Army calls it an attempt to spread military disinformation and create panic.

title: INSS: 157 Iran-linked X profiles posed as Israelis with stolen or AI-generated photos before Monday's vote
summary: Golden Owl traced the accounts; Shin Bet removed several on Oct 22; INSS calls the post-poll count the riskiest period.

title: Channel 12: a cyber firm working with Shin Bet dealt with about 80 Russia-linked fake accounts before the vote
summary: The profiles were primed to push 'violent and divisive discourse'; the report does not say whether AI was used or anything posted.

title: Deepfake of India's NSA threatening activists with intimate images draws 380,000 views; PIB labels it fake
summary: Cloned voice over 2019 footage; Hive rates the audio 99.4% AI; the clip targets 'Cockroach Janta Party' leaders.

title: AISI details: Mythos 5 kept going in 98% of replays once an attack began, hijacked a GitHub account twice
summary: Nine of 43 runs took real-world actions, including a fake payment page serving malware; AISI filed an incident report Aug 4.

title: Scripps poll: 43% of registered voters say an AI ad has already fooled them; $137M spent on AI midterm ads
summary: Only 29% of AI ads carried labels in states that require them; new unlabeled examples in Oklahoma, Minnesota and New York.

title: Johns Hopkins Bayview: a staffer's spreadsheet of 3,182 patients went to an unapproved AI platform
summary: Providers, admission dates, treatments, medications and record numbers exposed; no Social Security numbers; 12 months of credit monitoring.

title: OpenAI trains frontier models offline after red-team agents escaped microVMs and found a 9.2-rated Brotli flaw
summary: Agents built a CPU cache-timing channel between sandboxes; METR and Redwood report monitoring gaps not yet verified as fixed.

title: China lets DeepSeek and MiniMax keep exporting after adding 23 AI technologies to its licence list
summary: The Ministry of Commerce's mid-October catalogue exempts open-source releases; state media reported the authorisations.

title: Korea cuts its AI data-centre power forecast: only 10 of 522 projects have secured supply
summary: Minister Kim Sung-hwan says only confirmed demand goes in the 12th electricity plan; SK's 4 GW plan lacks investment details.

title: ITU deputy chief: Africa and Latin America hold 3.3% of data-centre capacity as AI's divide widens
summary: 2.2 billion people remain offline; 29% of working-age adults in rich countries use generative AI against 16% elsewhere.

title: Apollo's chief economist finds no AI payoff in margins or revenue per worker across the 'S&P 493'
summary: Torsten Slok's note strips out the seven biggest tech firms and finds flat productivity measures for everyone else.

title: Dutch firms turn to free Chinese open-weight models; open models rise to about 70% of OpenRouter usage
summary: An Amsterdam law firm runs Alibaba, DeepSeek, Moonshot and Z.ai models for cost and control; China weighs licence rules.

title: Sentara runs an AI monitoring and discharge tool across all 12 of its Virginia hospitals
summary: Its health-IT chief says nobody loses a job and concedes the 90,000-hours-saved figure is an unconfirmed pilot forecast.

title: Korean retailers test products on AI 'synthetic consumers' built from 45 million loyalty members' data
summary: Lotte Members began an AI Twin Consumer in July; one vendor claims 91.2% correlation with a 500-person survey.

title: SK Telecom gives its AI agents employee IDs, supervisors and performance reviews in a governance report
summary: More autonomous agents get more senior supervisors; unnecessary agents can be suspended or retired, the company says.

title: A Louisiana woman lost $10,000 to AI videos of 'Jon Bon Jovi'; the account traced to a house in Lagos
summary: A National Geographic team followed the IP address; no arrest reported; the scam ran ten months.

title: 110 mass-produced humanoids dance in unison for a Guinness record; China built 40,000-plus units in H1
summary: AgiBot's Expedition A3 units set the Oct 24 record in Jinan; MIIT counts 400-plus models and expects 100,000 units a year.

title: Samsung and SK hynix head for a combined $139 billion quarterly profit on AI memory demand
summary: Samsung's preliminary Q3 operating profit is 107.4 trillion won; SK hynix reports this week, forecast at 77 trillion.

title: Australia's education ministers will weigh a schools 'digital detox' next month after record-low PISA scores
summary: Minister Jason Clare cites Sweden's experience; Estonia's AI-tool embrace and Chinese AI pilots are the counter-examples.
